text:
anya: Quick report — our sampleapp fails only when bundled for Workers/Vercel Edge. Node dev works. Error: "Cannot access 'exports' before initialization".

kevin: Likely mixed CJS/ESM in the SDK. Which import pattern are you using?

anya: `import Redwood from 'redwood-js-sdk'` in TS app, package.json has "type": "module". Rollup bundle shows `exports.__esModule` lines.

riley: Rollup commonjs plugin can create circular bindings if CJS blobs are wrapped. Quick workaround: change to `import * as Redwood` or force SDK ESM via conditional exports.

anya: Minimal repro: Rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs -> worker runtime crash. I can DM the private repro repo.

kevin: Proposed SDK fixes: publish separate dist/esm and dist/cjs, add conditional "exports" map, ensure ESM build avoids any `exports` or `module.exports` assignments, and ship a default-friendly d.ts so TS consumers don't rely on esModuleInterop.

ci-bot: Created issue #371: "redwood-js-sdk: mixed CJS/ESM causes Worker init error" and attached repro.

riley: For integrators: Vite -> use `ssr.noExternal: ['redwood-js-sdk']`. Rollup -> prefer SDK ESM entry, or set commonjs plugin `transformMixedEsModules: true`.

anya: Thanks — will open PR with export map + interop typing tomorrow.
